g.textArea: How data moves through Master Scheduling v2.5, left to right. Colour tells you where every value comes from.

rect.data-description: INPUT (typed). Typed by a person, either in this workbook or in the external _BC.xlsm file. Change these and everything downstream moves.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Pasted in from a Business Central report. Refreshed by the planner, never calculated.
FORMULA (this sheet). Calculated from cells on the same sheet or table.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Pulled from another sheet, table, or the external _BC.xlsm file (XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP).

rect.data-title: Grey: printed output or not used
rect.data-description: OUTPUT. A printed run sheet or pivot, or a column no formula reads.
ISSUE. Something that gives a wrong or missing number today. The most important are ranked in section 10.
NOTE. Explanation, worked example or saved state. Not a cell in the workbook.

NOTE. Sections run left to right in data-flow order. In each: the flowchart on the left, then one card stack per table in column order, then a red Issues stack. Open a card to read the full formula and what it feeds.

NOTE. v2.5: line totals are one SUMIFS on Asset (the 14 disagreeing hand-typed chains are gone), dough rows roll up by SUMIFS, master data moved into Excel tables. v2.6: Mix Order Backup deleted (its order is now Original Mix Order in Products and Dough), Mix_Slice_Oven renamed Mix_Slice, Recon made a table.
INPUT (typed). Table Products, 478 items. Master item list: line (Asset), dough, unique dough, weight, scrap, pans. Section 1.
INPUT (typed). Table Dough, 63 D-codes. Weight (lb per bag) is a SUMIFS on BOMQty. Section 1.
INPUT (typed). Table UniqueDough, 139 mixing runs: schedule placement, bags per mix, minutes per mix. Section 1.
INPUT (typed). Table Pans, 41 pans and boxes: pieces per pan, trays per bag. Feeds Oven_Info. Section 1.
INPUT (typed). Still live. The schedules read run notes, attributes and bag-mix run times from its D:O copy, not from Unique Dough. Also pallet by customer and packs per case. Section 1.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Table SalesHistory, 203,445 posted invoice lines (5/2 to 9/23/2026). Only No., Posting Date and Quantity are used. Section 2.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Table SalesOrders, 1,438 open order lines. Feeds the Dist_DSnD order grids and the Dist Shipping pivot. Section 2.
NOT USED. Table14, 1,244 items. No live formula reads it. Section 2.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Sunday. Inventory day tab: every count is an XLOOKUP into the external _BC.xlsm file. Section 3.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Monday. Initial Inventory = Sunday Final Inventory; counts from _BC.xlsm. Section 3.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Tuesday. Same pattern as Monday. Section 3.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Wednesday. Same pattern as Monday. Section 3.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Thursday. Same pattern as Monday. Section 3.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Table Friday. Same pattern as Monday. Section 3.
FORMULA (this sheet). Tables DSD_DSnD (packs) and Dist_DSnD (cases): demand, balance, production per day. Section 4.
OUTPUT. PivotTable on Open Sales Lines, DIST lines only. Last refreshed 2026-09-18. Section 4.
FORMULA (this sheet). Table DoughWeight: pounds of dough needed per day. Also holds the pasted BOMQty export in O:AJ. Section 5.
FORMULA (this sheet). Two tables on one sheet. Mix_Slice: bags, planned bags, minutes and the slice sheet (section 6). Oven_Info: pans to set out (section 7). K4 picks the day.
OUTPUT. Printed mixer run sheet for MCS LINE, built by one dynamic-array formula in A5. Section 8.
OUTPUT. Printed mixer run sheet for Breadline and Breadline/Artisan, built by A5. Section 8.
FORMULA (this sheet). Table Recon: compares each spill-array row count with its table row count. Section 9.
NOT USED. Static notes. Nothing reads it and it reads nothing.
INPUT (typed). Typed Sunday of the week being planned: 2026-09-20. H3:M3 sample dates start at H2-6. Sheet note: update this date in every new template. Feeds: every demand average, DoughWeights F2.
INPUT (typed). Typed safety buffer = 1.2. Every DSD _Demand = ROUNDUP(average x C5). Dist_DSnD demand gets no buffer.
INPUT (typed). Typed dropdown = Tuesday. Picks the day for Planned Total, the slice sheet, Oven_Info and both schedules, while every header prints TODAY() = Saturday.
INPUT (typed). Typed date 2026-08-30. Monday to Friday B1 add one day each. Feeds only the Julian Date column.
INPUT (typed). Typed first-mix start: MCS 6:45, Breadline 7:50. Printed only; no finish times are calculated from it.
INPUT (typed). Typed per day on DSD_DSnD and Dist_DSnD. All blank today. Floor already includes Freezer, so typing here would double count.
INPUT (typed). Mix_Slice[Planned Total] = Optimal Total until a person types a number over it. None are overridden today.
ISSUE. Mix_Slice column X is meant for typed runouts, but no formula reads it. Typing a runout changes nothing.
